description: Named variables of the MonsterCybil's behaviour (chara/MonsterCybil/behavior.lua reads and writes them by name). Each character instance owns a small block of bytes; every entry of "fields" names one value in it: "name" is the name the script uses, "kind" the storage type (s8, u8, s16, u16, s32, u32: a write keeps the low bits, a read sign- or zero-extends), "at" the byte offset in the block (absent: the next naturally aligned offset), "note" what the value means. Values are raw integers in the units the behaviour uses (usually Q12, 4096 = 1.0 or 1 m; angles Q12, 4096 = a full turn). A mod adds or changes fields with a state.json of the same path; keep the offsets of fields the behaviour already uses.

fields.name: monster_cybil_legs_state
fields.note: The clip state of the legs and of the upper body (each its own little state machine).

fields.name: monster_cybil_aim_timer
fields.note: Time spent aiming before the shot (the cutscene freeze word).

fields.name: monster_cybil_second_phase
fields.note: 1 from the second phase of the fight on (she holds the gun ready).

fields.name: monster_cybil_stagger_damage
fields.note: Damage taken recently; past 800 she staggers (the cutscene reset word).

fields.name: monster_cybil_ambush_point
fields.note: The point of the ring she drops in from (index of the ambush points).

fields.name: monster_cybil_turn_timer
fields.note: Ticks since the last reposition, or the angle turned while dodging an obstacle.

fields.name: monster_cybil_on_screen_timer
fields.note: How long she has been on screen.

fields.name: monster_cybil_evade
fields.note: 0 fights, 1 wanders off, 2 / 3 turns right / left around an obstacle.
